t: DEWALT DCD778D2-SFGB 18V cordless combi drill combines power, precision, and portability for professional drilling and screwdriving tasks. Featuring a brushless motor with XR technology, the compact drill is equipped with 15+1+1 torque settings and delivers 65Nm max torque, to support hammer drilling in wood, metal, and masonry. The ergonomic, compact and lightweight design with rubber overmould grip, LED work light, and spindle lock ensures comfort, visibility, and quick bit changes on any job site. An intelligent trigger ensures optimal handling. Supplied with 2 x 2Ah Li-Ion batteries and XR charger.
